sources_read_without_records.reason: Threats to the species in the Sahel (cattle density, fire, trade); names no food plant.

animal_history_exclusions.note: Lambert (1993, p. 41): 'a previously captive female G. sulcata collected from near Mourdiah ... was observed to feed on the leaves of annual grass tufts Eleusine indica' when allowed to roam freely beside agricultural land. Wording read in the article in unit 2. Not counted as an independent wild-population observation.

gaps_not_filled: no field study of the wild diet of Centrochelys sulcata was found in units 1-5; the only field-setting feeding record is Lambert 1993: one previously captive female, allowed to roam near agricultural land, seen eating Eleusine indica; it is not a wild-population observation
no tortoise-specific nutrient analysis of hay was found; the hay values added are livestock feed tables
